meta_state_law_citations_007.answer: Pursuant to Florida Statutes, an employee may request and will be granted an unpaid leave of absence to accept employment in an instructional position at a District Charter School. | The Association agrees not to engage in any conduct prohibited by Florida Statute Chapter 447 - Sections 505 and 507. | Nothing contained in this grievance procedure shall be construed to deny any employee, the Association, the Superintendent or the Board, their constitutional rights or rights under the laws of the State of Florida.
